hotels.title: Adults-Only Antigua Beachfront Haven with All-Inclusive Dining, Free-Flow Drinks & US$200 Spa Credit
hotels.description: Barefoot luxury awaits at this adults-only tropical oasis set along Antigua's pristine shoreline. Boasting top-tier facilities, endless entertainment options and a variety of bars and restaurants, this indulgent retreat is designed to cater to your every whim. Discover the island's crystalline waters by paddle board, kayak or sail boat, or opt for a yoga session or leisurely cycle. With unlimited dining and drinks included in your stay, taste and sip your way across the resort's eight restaurants and bars, ranging from European fine dining at Ismay’s Restaurant & Bar to long lunches with sand between your toes at Barefoot Grill. When you're not wining and dining, soak up the Caribbean sun by the pool or beach and take relaxation to the next level at Indulge Spa, set amid a peaceful lagoon.
